pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark patches exhibit irregular, multi-pointed geometries with jagged vertices and star-like projections. Edge gradients are distinct, transitioning from deep brown to the lighter tone of the surrounding network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream negative space forms thin pathways between patches. Junction nodes are frequent, typically connecting 3 to 5 patches in a dense topological web across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and back presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette characterized by short, dark vertical pixel extensions against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small dark avian subject is perched on the dorsal ridge near the posterior visible section of the torso. Additionally, a singular, high-contrast dark heart-shaped patch is visible on the lower ventral flank.
